title: सप्तदशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 17 · The kings gather and the rules of war

summary.en: As Vyasa had said, all the kings assemble and Sanjaya names the chiefs on both sides with their armies and banners. The rules of fair fighting between the two sides are recalled.
summary.kn: ವ್ಯಾಸರು ಹೇಳಿದಂತೆ ಎಲ್ಲ ರಾಜರೂ ಸೇರುತ್ತಾರೆ; ಸಂಜಯನು ಎರಡೂ ಪಕ್ಷಗಳ ಮುಖ್ಯಸ್ಥರನ್ನು ಅವರ ಸೈನ್ಯ, ಧ್ವಜಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಹೆಸರಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ನ್ಯಾಯಯುದ್ಧದ ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: जैसा व्यास ने कहा था, सब राजा एकत्र होते हैं और संजय दोनों पक्षों के प्रमुखों को उनकी सेनाओं और ध्वजाओं सहित गिनाते हैं। न्यायपूर्ण युद्ध के नियम स्मरण किए जाते हैं।
summary.te: వ్యాసుడు చెప్పినట్లు రాజులందరూ సమావేశమవుతారు; సంజయుడు ఇరుపక్షాల నాయకులను వారి సేనలు, ధ్వజాలతో పేర్కొంటాడు. న్యాయయుద్ధ నియమాలు గుర్తు చేయబడతాయి.
summary.ta: வியாசர் சொன்னபடி அரசர்கள் அனைவரும் கூடுகிறார்கள்; சஞ்சயன் இரு தரப்புத் தலைவர்களையும் அவர்களின் படைகள், கொடிகளுடன் பெயரிடுகிறான். நியாயப் போருக்கான விதிகள் நினைவுகூரப்படுகின்றன.
summary.ml: വ്യാസൻ പറഞ്ഞതുപോലെ എല്ലാ രാജാക്കന്മാരും ഒന്നിച്ചുകൂടുന്നു; സഞ്ജയൻ ഇരുപക്ഷത്തെയും പ്രധാനികളെയും അവരുടെ സേനകളെയും കൊടികളെയും പേരെടുത്ത് പറയുന്നു. ഇരുപക്ഷവും തമ്മിലുള്ള ന്യായയുദ്ധനിയമങ്ങൾ ഓർമിപ്പിക്കപ്പെടുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 6.17; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Mon Jul 26 2021

verses.text: संजय उवाच

meaning.en: Sanjaya said:

verses.text:
यथा स भगवान्व्यासः कृष्णद्वैपायनोऽब्रवीत् ।
तथैव सहिताः सर्वे समाजग्मुर्महीक्षितः ॥

meaning.en: Just as the blessed Vyasa Krishna Dvaipayana had said, so all the kings came together.

verses.text:
मघाविषयगः सोमस्तद्दिनं प्रत्यपद्यत ।
दीप्यमानाश्च संपेतुर्दिवि सप्त महाग्रहाः ॥

meaning.en: On that day the moon stood in the lunar house of Magha, and seven great planets blazing fell together in the sky.

verses.text:
द्विधाभूत इवादित्य उदये प्रत्यदृश्यत ।
ज्वलन्त्या शिखया भूयो भानुमानुदितो दिवि ॥

meaning.en: At sunrise the sun appeared as if split in two, and again it rose in the sky with a blazing flame.

verses.text:
ववाशिरे च दीप्तायां दिशि गोमायुवायसाः ।
लिप्समानाः शरीराणि मांसशोणितभोजनाः ॥

meaning.en: Jackals and crows cried out in the blazing quarter, wanting bodies, eaters of flesh and blood.

verses.text:
अहन्यहनि पार्थानां वृद्धः कुरुपितामहः ।
भरद्वाजात्मजश्चैव प्रातरुत्थाय संयतौ ॥

meaning.en: Day after day, the aged grandsire of the Kurus and the son of Bharadvaja, rising in the morning and self-controlled, said of the Pandavas, "May victory be to the sons of Pandu."

verses.text:
जयोऽस्तु पाण्डुपुत्राणामित्यूचतुररिंदमौ ।
युयुधाते तवार्थाय यथा स समयः कृतः ॥

meaning.en: And yet those two scourges of foes fought for your side, as the agreement had been made.

verses.text:
सर्वधर्मविशेषज्ञः पिता देवव्रतस्तव ।
समानीय महीपालानिदं वचनमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Your father Devavrata, who knew the special points of all dharma, gathered the kings and spoke these words.

verses.text:
इदं वः क्षत्रिया द्वारं स्वर्गायापावृतं महत् ।
गच्छध्वं तेन शक्रस्य ब्रह्मणश्च सलोकताम् ॥

meaning.en: "Kshatriyas, this great door to heaven is open for you; go by it to the world of Shakra and of Brahma."

verses.text:
एष वः शाश्वतः पन्थाः पूर्वैः पूर्वतरैर्गतः ।
संभावयत चात्मानमव्यग्रमनसो युधि ॥

meaning.en: "This is your eternal path, trodden by those of old and still earlier; honour yourselves with steady minds in battle."

verses.text:
नाभागो हि ययातिश्च मान्धाता नहुषो नृगः ।
संसिद्धाः परमं स्थानं गताः कर्मभिरीदृशैः ॥

meaning.en: "Nabhaga, Yayati, Mandhata, Nahusha and Nriga reached the highest state, perfected by such deeds."

verses.text:
अधर्मः क्षत्रियस्यैष यद्व्याधिमरणं गृहे ।
यदाजौ निधनं याति सोऽस्य धर्मः सनातनः ॥

meaning.en: "For a Kshatriya it is unrighteous to die of illness at home; death in battle is his eternal dharma."

verses.text:
एवमुक्ता महीपाला भीष्मेण भरतर्षभ ।
निर्ययुः स्वान्यनीकानि शोभयन्तो रथोत्तमैः ॥

meaning.en: Thus addressed by Bhishma, best of the Bharatas, the kings went forth with their divisions, adorning them with the best chariots.

verses.text:
स तु वैकर्तनः कर्णः सामात्यः सह बन्धुभिः ।
न्यासितः समरे शस्त्रं भीष्मेण भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: But Karna, son of Vikartana, with his ministers and kinsmen, had been made by Bhishma to lay down his weapons in battle, best of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
अपेतकर्णाः पुत्रास्ते राजानश्चैव तावकाः ।
निर्ययुः सिंहनादेन नादयन्तो दिशो दश ॥

meaning.en: Without Karna, your sons and your kings went forth, making the ten directions ring with lion-roars.

verses.text:
श्वेतैश्छत्रैः पताकाभिर्ध्वजवारणवाजिभिः ।
तान्यनीकान्यशोभन्त रथैरथ पदातिभिः ॥

meaning.en: Those divisions shone with white parasols, flags, banners, elephants and horses, with chariots and foot soldiers.

verses.text:
भेरीपणवशब्दैश्च पटहानां च निस्वनैः ।
रथनेमिनिनादैश्च बभूवाकुलिता मही ॥

meaning.en: The earth was shaken by the sounds of drums and tabors, the noise of kettledrums and the rumble of chariot wheels.

verses.text:
काञ्चनाङ्गदकेयूरैः कार्मुकैश्च महारथाः ।
भ्राजमाना व्यदृश्यन्त जङ्गमाः पर्वता इव ॥

meaning.en: The great chariot-warriors, with golden armlets and bracelets, and with bows, were seen shining like moving mountains.

verses.text:
तालेन महता भीष्मः पञ्चतारेण केतुना ।
विमलादित्यसंकाशस्तस्थौ कुरुचमूपतिः ॥

meaning.en: Bhishma stood as commander of the Kuru army, bright as the spotless sun, with a great palm banner of five stars.

verses.text:
ये त्वदीया महेष्वासा राजानो भरतर्षभ ।
अवर्तन्त यथादेशं राजञ्शांतनवस्य ते ॥

meaning.en: Bharata, King, your great archers, the kings, moved as the son of Shantanu directed.

verses.text:
स तु गोवासनः शैब्यः सहितः सर्वराजभिः ।
ययौ मातङ्गराजेन राजार्हेण पताकिना ।
पद्मवर्णस्त्वनीकानां सर्वेषामग्रतः स्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Shaibya Govasana, with all the kings, went on a king-worthy lord of elephants bearing a flag, lotus-hued, standing in front of all the divisions.

verses.text:
अश्वत्थामा ययौ यत्तः सिंहलाङ्गूलकेतनः ।
श्रुतायुश्चित्रसेनश्च पुरुमित्रो विविंशतिः ॥

meaning.en: Ashvatthama went forth carefully with a lion's tail as his banner, with Shrutayudha, Chitrasena, Purumitra and Vivimshati.

verses.text:
शल्यो भूरिश्रवाश्चैव विकर्णश्च महारथः ।
एते सप्त महेष्वासा द्रोणपुत्रपुरोगमाः ।
स्यन्दनैर्वरवर्णाभैर्भीष्मस्यासन्पुरःसराः ॥

meaning.en: Shalya, Bhurishravas and the great chariot-warrior Vikarna: these seven great archers, led by Drona's son, were in the van of Bhishma in chariots of fine colour.

verses.text:
तेषामपि महोत्सेधाः शोभयन्तो रथोत्तमान् ।
भ्राजमाना व्यदृश्यन्त जाम्बूनदमया ध्वजाः ॥

meaning.en: Their lofty golden banners were seen shining, adorning the best of chariots.

verses.text:
जाम्बूनदमयी वेदिः कमण्डलुविभूषिता ।
केतुराचार्यमुख्यस्य द्रोणस्य धनुषा सह ॥

meaning.en: The banner of Drona, chief of teachers, was a golden altar adorned with a water pot, together with a bow.

verses.text:
अनेकशतसाहस्रमनीकमनुकर्षतः ।
महान्दुर्योधनस्यासीन्नागो मणिमयो ध्वजः ॥

meaning.en: As he led an army of many hundreds of thousands, Duryodhana's great banner, a jewelled elephant, was there.

verses.text:
तस्य पौरवकालिङ्गौ काम्बोजश्च सुदक्षिणः ।
क्षेमधन्वा सुमित्रश्च तस्थुः प्रमुखतो रथाः ॥

meaning.en: The Paurava, the Kalinga, Sudakshina of the Kambojas, Kshemadhanva and Sumitra stood in chariots at the front of him.

verses.text:
स्यन्दनेन महार्हेण केतुना वृषभेण च ।
प्रकर्षन्निव सेनाग्रं मागधश्च नृपो ययौ ॥

meaning.en: The king of Magadha went on a costly chariot with a bull banner, as though drawing the front of the army forward.

verses.text:
तदङ्गपतिना गुप्तं कृपेण च महात्मना ।
शारदाभ्रचयप्रख्यं प्राच्यानामभवद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: Guarded by the lord of Anga and by the great-souled Kripa, the army of the easterners looked like a mass of autumn clouds.

verses.text:
अनीकप्रमुखे तिष्ठन्वराहेण महायशाः ।
शुशुभे केतुमुख्येन राजतेन जयद्रथः ॥

meaning.en: Standing at the head of the army, the greatly famed Jayadratha shone with a silver boar as his chief standard.

verses.text:
शतं रथसहस्राणां तस्यासन्वशवर्तिनः ।
अष्टौ नागसहस्राणि सादिनामयुतानि षट् ॥

meaning.en: A hundred thousand chariots were under his sway, eight thousand elephants and sixty thousand horsemen.

verses.text:
तत्सिन्धुपतिना राजन्पालितं ध्वजिनीमुखम् ।
अनन्तरथनागाश्वमशोभत महद्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: King, the front of that army, guarded by the lord of Sindhu, shone as a great force with endless chariots, elephants and horses.

verses.text:
षष्ट्या रथसहस्रैस्तु नागानामयुतेन च ।
पतिः सर्वकलिङ्गानां ययौ केतुमता सह ॥

meaning.en: The lord of all the Kalingas went with his banner, with sixty thousand chariots and ten thousand elephants.

verses.text:
तस्य पर्वतसंकाशा व्यरोचन्त महागजाः ।
यन्त्रतोमरतूणीरैः पताकाभिश्च शोभिताः ॥

meaning.en: His great elephants shone like mountains, adorned with machines, javelins, quivers and flags.

verses.text:
शुशुभे केतुमुख्येन पादपेन कलिङ्गपः ।
श्वेतच्छत्रेण निष्केण चामरव्यजनेन च ॥

meaning.en: The Kalinga king shone with a tree as his chief banner, with a white parasol, a golden chain and a chowry.

verses.text:
केतुमानपि मातङ्गं विचित्रपरमाङ्कुशम् ।
आस्थितः समरे राजन्मेघस्थ इव भानुमान् ॥

meaning.en: King, Ketuman too, mounted on a lordly elephant with a wondrous goad, was like the sun in a cloud in the battle.

verses.text:
तेजसा दीप्यमानस्तु वारणोत्तममास्थितः ।
भगदत्तो ययौ राजा यथा वज्रधरस्तथा ॥

meaning.en: Blazing with splendour and mounted on a noble elephant, King Bhagadatta went like the wielder of the thunderbolt.

verses.text:
गजस्कन्धगतावास्तां भगदत्तेन संमितौ ।
विन्दानुविन्दावावन्त्यौ केतुमन्तमनुव्रतौ ॥

meaning.en: Vinda and Anuvinda of Avanti, devoted to Ketuman, rode on elephants' shoulders, matching Bhagadatta.

verses.text:
स रथानीकवान्व्यूहो हस्त्यङ्गोत्तमशीर्षवान् ।
वाजिपक्षः पतन्नुग्रः प्राहरत्सर्वतोमुखः ॥

meaning.en: That formation, with chariots as its army, the best part of elephants as its head, horses as its wings, fierce and falling, struck from every side.

verses.text:
द्रोणेन विहितो राजन्राज्ञा शांतनवेन च ।
तथैवाचार्यपुत्रेण बाह्लीकेन कृपेण च ॥

meaning.en: King, it was arranged by Drona and by the king, the son of Shantanu, and likewise by the teacher's son, by Bahlika and by Kripa.
